title: GrowWithHR Contract Workforce Wave 5K Governed Cross-Family Source Catalogue

sourcePack.name: GrowWithHR Contract Workforce bounded OSHWC plus EPF/ESI dependency snapshot
sourcePack.notes: Wave 5K reuses the existing OSHWC source identities and exact controlled Social Security/EPF/ESI files. Maharashtra OSHWC Labour Rules remain draft-only. EPF and ESI remain separate deterministic dependency reviews and are not subsumed into the contract-workforce result.

limitations: The catalogue remains needs-legal-review and is not an OSHWC contract-labour applicability, threshold, principal-employer/contractor classification, licensing, wage, core-activity, EPF, ESI, enforcement or remedy determination.
Only privacy-safe organisation-level source/dependency controls and controlled references are eligible for retrieval context.
Maharashtra draft rules cannot be treated as final. EPF and ESI source material can explain dependency boundaries but cannot be used to create cross-family applicability or contribution conclusions.

chunks.title: OSHWC contract-labour statutory boundary
chunks.text: OSHWC Chapter XI Part I contains the contract-labour framework, including applicability, licensing, work-order information, welfare responsibility, wage responsibility and core-activity restrictions. Wave 5K records organisation-level source and dependency controls only and does not decide whether Part I applies, classify a principal employer or contractor, calculate thresholds, approve a licence or determine a prohibited core activity.

chunks.title: Current Central Rules licensing and work-order boundary
chunks.text: The 2026 Central Rules contain contract-labour licensing, security, contractor responsibility and work-order processes. Wave 5K records whether a controlled licensing and work-order source route exists; it does not decide whether a licence is required, select a licence category, calculate fees or security, or validate any work order.

chunks.title: Welfare responsibility source boundary
chunks.text: The current Central Rules allocate contract-labour welfare responsibilities between principal employer and contractor in specified circumstances. Wave 5K reviews only whether an organisation has a governed responsibility-source control and cannot determine factual breach, facility sufficiency, worker entitlement or liability.

chunks.title: Contract-labour wage-responsibility source boundary
chunks.text: The current Central Rules contain contractor wage-payment duties and a principal-employer fallback when the contractor fails to pay within the prescribed process. Wave 5K records a source-control and escalation status only; it does not process payroll, determine unpaid wages, calculate amounts, decide recovery or adjudicate liability.

chunks.title: Core-activity prohibition source boundary
chunks.text: Questions about whether an activity is a core activity or whether contract labour is prohibited require the statutory designated-authority route. Wave 5K cannot classify customer activities, infer exceptions or decide a prohibition; it records only whether the classification-source and specialist-escalation controls are present.

chunks.title: Explicit EPF/ESI dependency boundary
chunks.text: Rule 93(4) links contract-labour social-security treatment to the respective provisions of the Code on Social Security. Wave 5K therefore treats EPF and ESI as separate dependency controls and never uses the OSHWC review to decide EPF membership, ESI insurance, contribution rates, payroll or remittance outcomes.

chunks.title: Maharashtra draft-rule boundary
chunks.text: Maharashtra continues to publish its OSHWC Labour Rules, 2026 as draft rules. Wave 5K may record this source identity and a draft-versus-final reconciliation control but cannot treat the draft as operative, infer a final State rule or determine a Maharashtra-specific contract-labour obligation.

chunks.title: EPF contractor dependency boundary
chunks.text: Section 17 of the controlled Code on Social Security provides principal-employer and contractor contribution context for the EPF branch. Wave 5K does not duplicate the dedicated EPF contractor-control rule; it records only whether that separate dependency is routed and reviewed.

chunks.title: EPF contractor operational-control dependency
chunks.text: The controlled Employees' Provident Funds Scheme source supplies contractor operational-control context. Wave 5K may cite it only to explain the separate EPF dependency; worker names, UANs, wage rows, contribution histories and ECR bodies remain outside the cross-family payload.

chunks.title: ESI contractor and contribution dependency boundary
chunks.text: The controlled Code on Social Security provides the ESI contribution and principal-employer responsibility framework. Wave 5K does not duplicate the dedicated ESI contractor-control rule and cannot decide insurance, wage ceilings, area coverage, rates, payment amounts or liability.

chunks.title: ESI saved-law contractor-process dependency
chunks.text: The controlled ESI General Regulations are retained as saved-law candidate context for contractor registers, contribution process and returns. Wave 5K preserves the existing ESI transition limitation and cannot treat these provisions as a complete prospective current-law answer without the dedicated ESI review.

chunks.title: Cross-family current-rules reconciliation boundary
chunks.sectionReference: Social Security (Central) Rules, 2026 and existing EPF/ESI governed routes
chunks.text: The contract-workforce review must keep OSHWC, EPF and ESI decisions separate even when the same workforce relationship is involved. Wave 5K records dependency readiness and reconciliation only; it cannot use one family result as a substitute for another family’s applicability, contribution, insurance or enforcement decision.
